name: Sakaki
source: One of the characters of the Correctness storyline. She is a detective in the Heinous Crimes Unit. Personality-wise, she is a rather average young woman who prefers to stay on the good side of her superiors. [spoiler]She is killed by a postman while investigating the victim's room having barely started working on the case.[/spoiler]
